entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely useless.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can you please provide me with your order number?
Ugh, fine. It's VF8675309. This is ridiculous, the quality is terrible.

Thank you. I'm pulling up your order for the Aero Race Jersey now... Okay, I see it. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong size! It's advertised as a performance fit, not a sausage casing! This thing is way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. I want to return it for a refund, not an exchange.
I understand your frustration with the fit, and I'm sorry to hear the sizing wasn't what you expected.
Don't give me your scripted apology! Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager? I swear I will post a review on every single website about this.

There's no need for a manager, I can absolutely handle this for you. I've just reviewed your purchase date, and since you received the item 54 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. I can approve this return for a full refund right now.
Oh. So you're just... doing it? Why didn't you just say that from the start?

I just needed to confirm the details, sir. I've just initiated the return process. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
Fine. So I'll get all my money back?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. Once our warehouse receives the jersey, the refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. That's it. Just make sure that email comes through.
It has been sent. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
